text: It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival 2020” on G-Sports.com. And, you can thank your luck you took your turn when you jumped over one of the 1357896 spots, or didn’t. Actually, thank Stephen Smail and his family. He and his team of programmers and testers spent several months working on two programs. The first, simply named “Survival,” plays in a jungle scenario. You start with about 7,500 resources in your bank. You need to survive 30 days in the jungle. The second program added two years to your journey, but the stakes remained the same. Survival 2020 added a few more obstacles to that 7,500 Resources. While Smail’s team of developers is the one that made the survival apps, Smail is one of the testers. “He’s been a long-time user of G-Sports.com,” said Kevin Moore, Public Relations and Special Services director for the Cherokee Nation and G-Sports.com director. “Our systems administrator, Bruce Martin, did some programming for Smail years ago. Now Stephen is taking advantage of the G-Sports systems in a way to benefit the Cherokee Nation and his fellow Cherokee Nation members.” Unlike most online casino games, Survival may not show in the balance of profits for the Cherokee Nation, Moore said. He does know that the program will generate some income, but the amounts will be less than other online lottery-type games. “We have another online casino game, Bingo. It is a program used to create a digital currency lottery that gives away prizes. The system returns us about $100 a month. It is a long time since I have looked at the world after submitting the map, but I decided to do it and post as long note as possible. “Survival Island” is about to survive! …It has been … or I had been playing in my PC from a week ago. Thanks for the comments in Issue 1 and 2! Some items are added a little too late. In the beginning of the issue 2, my post is shown “The island is getting into its true natural state in this issue”, but that was not the case. I realized I had made a mistake in making new environment in Issue 2, from about Issue 5. Some part that I was going to grow after this period, it has become a short plant instead. Environmental changes does not show on the map of the game itself, unfortunately, but it has brought me a lot of trouble; the part of my world that I played before was… a place I started play my map. Therefore, my earlier environmental area has a lot of rocks because the ecology has not changed yet in that area. It is not because of my lack of interest in world-building, but I started my game over once or twice because I forgot where I was to play and had to restart my game. Therefore, I made a little change in the next issue. Although the player character or local area has not changed, I made a global change. The world is again getting into its true natural state. It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival Run” mode here. Thanks for all the feedback since then. More changes are soon to follow .

After starting a few games, it was starting to be fun, so I thought I would continue the game, seeing if I could get to 10,000!

The game has reached 882985767 and not many play anymore… as you can imagine it is getting difficult to find players a lot. I’ll stop after 882985800. I guess this game was good but not as much as I imagined. It’s really sad :(

I think I want to add a few more options, and a few more features before I stop thinking about this game :).

There will be more coming, a new feature is “The Wing Events” The Wing Event is a challenge in the game. When you gain energy a specific enemy may appear for a very short period of time:

-Wing Dragon

-White Tiger

-Lighting Tiger

-Red Dragon etc…

Once a Wing is summoned different challenges will be unlocked [ 2, 3, 4 and 5 will be unlocked aswell ].

After 5 challenges a new version will be unlocked.

After the game starts the first Wing will appear after a 30 minutes period of time, and will re appear every 30 minutes.

The first Wing will appear here and will be Health + 1,000 HP.

The second Wing will appear here (Here). Re-appearing every 30 minutes. A slight change in this one is a random wing will appear (The same as in the first one).

The third Wing will appear here and will have health + 1,000 HP and a small change if the Health is missing, the Wing will be health -1000 HP.

The fourth Wing will appear here and will have slightly faster wings I think
